# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated from web/src/lib/shortcuts.ts, the table the app's own shortcuts sheet shows. Do not edit by hand: run `UPDATE_MANUAL=1 npx vitest run src/manual`. -->

Press `?` anywhere in the app (outside a text field or terminal) for this list as a sheet: [Open the shortcuts sheet](app:sheet/shortcuts). Two keys written "`g` then `j`" are a sequence: press `g`, then the second key within a second and a half.

The `g` sequences and `?` do nothing while you type in a field or a terminal, so they never steal a letter from a shell or a message.

## Anywhere

| On a Mac | Elsewhere | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `⌘ K` | `Ctrl K` | Command palette (also from inside a terminal) (elsewhere: Command palette (not inside a terminal, where Ctrl K is the shell's)) |
| `?` | `?` | Keyboard shortcuts (this sheet), with the way into the manual |
| `T` | `T` | Next theme (Settings → Appearance has them all) |
| `g` then `h` | `g` then `h` | Go to Now |
| `g` then `j` | `g` then `j` | Go to Jobs |
| `g` then `p` | `g` then `p` | Go to Projects |
| `g` then `c` | `g` then `c` | Go to Chat |
| `g` then `i` | `g` then `i` | Go to Inbox |
| `g` then `a` | `g` then `a` | Go to Agents |
| `g` then `m` | `g` then `m` | Go to Help |
| `g` then `n` | `g` then `n` | Focus the needs-you tray (then y or n answers the approval you open) |

## In the palette

| On a Mac | Elsewhere | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `↑` / `↓` | `↑` / `↓` | Move (also Ctrl N, Ctrl P) |
| `↵` | `↵` | Run the highlighted item |
| `⌘ ↵` | `Ctrl ↵` | Its second action: the full job form, send and open Chat, the other view; else its actions |
| `→` | `→` | Its actions (also Tab) |
| `esc` | `esc` | Back a level, then close (focus returns where it was) |
| `>` | `>` | At the start: give what follows as a job (so does “job …”) |

## Views

| On a Mac | Elsewhere | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `⌘ ↵` | `Ctrl ↵` | Jobs: give the job in the text box |
| `↵` | `↵` | Chat: send (Shift ↵ for a new line), from a wide screen |
| `/` | `/` | Fleet: filter the agents |
| `Space` | `Space` | Chat: hold to talk, let go to send (outside a text field; a quick tap does nothing) |
| `⌥ Space` | `Ctrl Space` | Chat, in the message box: hold to talk |
| `esc` | `esc` | Close a sheet or menu; cancel a recording |
| `←` / `→` | `←` / `→` | Move between tabs |
| `j` / `k` | `j` / `k` | Changes: next and previous file |
| `n` / `p` | `n` / `p` | Changes: next and previous change |
| `v` | `v` | Changes: mark the current file viewed (again to unmark) |
| `c` | `c` | Changes: comment on the selected lines (or the focused line, else the whole file) |
| `f` | `f` | Changes: full screen (esc leaves it) |
